verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo states Firecrawl is open source under AGPL-3.0 and available both as open source and as a hosted service, so the core product can be run on your own infrastructure. A community comment confirms the AGPL code can be forked and modified freely. However, the cloud version includes additional features not in the open-source release, and community notes say the open-source version lacks a proxy service. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting setup/deployment guide, clarity on which features are cloud-only (e.g. proxy), independent hands-on self-host reports.
